item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151329","version_id":"a5a6e64fd4f2a87b5b45be5afd0c01d19fd3ee1e8b8f12be9e7e49964e03d82b","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, dated engineering-software coverage directly relevant to AI-assisted CAD and simulation: it reports SimScale's Onshape agent can propose setups, mesh, run physics, and return results, alongside Comsol's planned MCP server. The quoted SimScale statement is a commercial claim about workflow capability, not evidence that its setups or results are correct; verification would require disclosed task conditions, solver settings, and comparisons with engineer-reviewed simulation outcomes. It also corrects the record on Autodesk neural-CAD features, a useful credibility and novelty signal, while the Comsol release remains prospective rather than deployed evidence.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
